q.songTitle: (Are You) the One That I’ve Been Waiting For?
q.line: Out of sorrow entire worlds have been built
stanza: Out of sorrow entire worlds have been built
Out of longing great wonders have been willed
They're only little tears, darling, let them spill
And lay your head upon my shoulder
Outside my window the world has gone to war
Are you the one that I've been waiting for?

partner.line: Out of longing great wonders have been willed

q.line: Make you wonder why you were even built
stanza: Suffering jukebox
Such a sad machine
You're all filled up with what other people mean
Hardship, damnation and guilt
Make you wonder why you were even built
Suffering jukebox
In a happy town
You're over in the corner breaking down
They always seem to keep you way down low
The people in this town don't want to know

q.line: I live in a city sorrow built
stanza: Sorrow's my body on the waves
Sorrow's a girl inside my cake
I live in a city sorrow built
It's in my honey, it's in my milk

partner.line: It's in my honey, it's in my milk

q.line: And I'm filled with a dirty white guilt
stanza: She's my sweet, sweet Candy May
Got me stuck and I want to stay
But I never wanted to look sharp

So I live with a deep regret
Of all I do on the internet
And I'm filled with a dirty white guilt
She's a bride and adorned in frills

q.line: So my life and my whole weight in guilt

That voice loud and plain

I owned up to it
Though leaving is a curious way
For you to love me
So my life and my whole weight in guilt
